about: FireSim vs Pyra parity fixture. Inputs captured read-only at captured_at; synthetic variants are marked in each case's 'what'. 'pyra' holds the results of Pyra's own engine (run_pyra_parity.mjs) at pyra_commit; FireSim must reproduce them.

sources.gem: Open-Meteo forecast API, Pyra fetchWeather URL (models=gem_seamless)

cwfis_transform.rep_date_today: every feature's rep_date set to today's date (T12:00:00Z)

transforms.prev_rep_date: every carry-over entry's repDate set to this date (T12:00:00Z)
